title: Guardian of the Mystic Orb
description: A pair of hands holds a glowing miniature Earth emitting warm light from below. Behind it floats a massive translucent purple cosmic entity with large round eyes, bubbles, and jellyfish-like forms swirling within a vortex against a dark background.
prompt: A pair of pale hands cupping a small glowing globe showing the Earth with visible continents and oceans, radiating warm golden light from below. Looming behind is a giant translucent purple cosmic creature with large cartoonish eyes and teal highlights, swirling vortex of bubbles and glowing jellyfish-like organisms floating inside its form, dark teal background, dramatic fantasy atmosphere, ethereal lighting
